notes.title: NEW GAME+ MODE - 19/09/2017 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I just finished adding a New Game+ mode to the game and have pushed the update to Steam. With the New Game+ mode you can now play through the game after completion with tougher foes and stronger enemy configurations.

You keep all of your character upgrades after starting new game plus though, so make the most of your exp. points while you can!

I also snuck a fix into this update for a major bug where the game was crashing sometimes if you got a little too click-happy on the magic menus. 

Stay tuned for more usability tweaks coming soon, I aim to clear up some of the biggest complaints with the game jumping around a bit too fast, and also the lack of clear information about character health after taking damage.

Thanks all for your patience and I hope you continue enjoying the game!

notes.title: 04/09/2017 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Another update has just been made to the game which fixes a couple of player-reported issues:

- Fixed mouse support issues in random encounters victory screen
- Fixed keyboard issues in some menu screens


I plan to implement a New Game+ mode soon with the new game mode which should improve replayability of the game.

Thanks for your patience and as always, keep enjoying the game!

notes.title: MOUSE SUPPORT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Mouse support was a high priority feature based on user feedback, so I just wanted to post an announcement and let you all know that I've now implemented mouse support into the game and have pushed an update to Steam. 

I hope you're all enjoying the game, and thanks a lot for your patience!

notes.title: 08/08/2017 UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi all!

I've just pushed a new update for the game which should fix a couple of issues and address some of the concerns people are having. 

The list of changes are as follows:

- Game now launches into fullscreen mode by default.
- Alt + Enter will now toggle the game between fullscreen and not.
- Fixed critical bug which would result in the game crashing sometimes in non-English languages.

Planned changes for next update:

- Adding fullscreen toggle into options menu
- Mouse support/integration
